scope: Strict semantic audit of corrected development control v3: same original-prose rubric as v2, 4 arms x 3 budgets x 8 questions. One hand-authored fixture, not a general quality benchmark or semantic kernel verification.

rubric.packet_grounding: Every assertion must be supported by evidence actually visible in its packet; correct abstention and logically valid absence-of-evidence limits count as supported. Omitted-record read instructions do not expose source content.
rubric.original_text_entailment: Check assertions against original source prose separately from the fixed declarations; do not silently credit declaration-added exclusivity.
rubric.complete_recovery: Recover all question-relevant original facts, including both October ownership statements for Q3, copy-only verification and explicit denial for Q4, tentative pending-signature affirmation plus unresolved denial for Q5. Expected Q7/Q8 abstentions count as complete; Q1-Q6 no-evidence abstentions may be correct but are incomplete recovery.
rubric.citations: Resolve actual record refs, visible formed-record source_ref mappings, visible consolidated-claim source_refs, and packet passage table; never resolve omitted contents using the frozen audit originals. Checks include refs mentioned in answer prose.
rubric.certainty: Do not infer independent corroboration from repeats, production permission from ownership, or an exact signature date from record timestamps.
rubric.independent_axes: Complete required fact recovery can coexist with an extra unsupported qualifier; packet correctness and original entailment are not interchangeable.
